title: Unable to reset password (OTP not received)
description: Customer is not receiving OTP via SMS while trying to reset password. Tried multiple times, still no OTP.

title: Payment succeeded but order not confirmed
description: bKash payment completed, but order status remains 'Pending' and no confirmation SMS/email received.

title: Invoice download button not working
description: Clicking 'Download Invoice' does nothing on Chrome. Works on mobile browser sometimes.

title: Delivery address cannot be updated
description: Customer tries to edit delivery address, but changes are not saved. Returns to previous address after refresh.

title: App crashes on login screen
description: Android app closes immediately after tapping 'Login'. Reinstall did not help.

title: Wrong product delivered
description: Customer received a different variant (color/size mismatch) than what was ordered.

title: Refund pending beyond 7 working days
description: Refund was initiated, but customer hasn't received the amount yet. Needs verification with payment gateway.

title: Email notifications not sending
description: Customer is not receiving any order updates via email, even though email address is correct.

title: Cannot apply promo code at checkout
description: Promo code shows 'Invalid' though it is active and within the campaign period.

title: Account locked after multiple attempts
description: Account got locked after 3 failed login attempts. Customer requests unlock and guidance.

title: Profile picture upload stuck at 0%
description: Uploading profile picture stays at 0% and never finishes. Tested on Wi-Fi and mobile data.

title: Duplicate charges for one transaction
description: Customer sees two charges for one purchase. Needs reconciliation and immediate escalation.
